source.title: UV Unwrapping in Blender (Full Beginner Tutorial) #b3d
source.creator: CG Boost

analysis.study_scope: Character head and eye UV unwrapping, seam placement, relaxation, pinning, texel density optimization, and mirror modifier UV workflows from 50:00 to 59:06.

episodes.observed_fact: Instructor marks top, bottom, and rear edge seams on the neck.
episodes.instructor_claim: Isolating the neck cylinder and cutting the back hides seams.
episodes.interpretation: Boundary seams plus a rear cut flatten cylindrical neck mesh smoothly.
episodes.hypothesis: Front neck seams would be noticeably visible.
episodes.reference_evidence: Neck island unwraps flatly in UV editor.
episodes.modeling_decision: Mark top/bottom loop seams and a back vertical seam.
episodes.visible_action: Selected top/bottom neck loops and back seam, marked seams, unwrapped.
episodes.spoken_reason: Cut top, bottom, and back of neck to hide seams.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Isolates neck into a flat UV island.
episodes.transferable_principle: Isolate cylindrical mesh sections using ring seams and a longitudinal back seam.

episodes.problem: Unwrapping head dome without face distortion.
episodes.observed_fact: Instructor marks seam from back neck up to hairline.
episodes.instructor_claim: Cutting up to hairline opens head UVs sideways, hiding seam under hair.
episodes.interpretation: Splitting posterior head lets face unfold flat without split features.
episodes.hypothesis: Seams across forehead would show texture seams.
episodes.reference_evidence: Head UV island spreads laterally with clean facial grid.
episodes.modeling_decision: Mark back-head seam stopping at hairline.
episodes.visible_action: Selected back-head path to hairline, marked seam, unwrapped.
episodes.spoken_reason: Cut back of head to hairline to keep forehead clean.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Head UV unfolds laterally, flattening face region.
episodes.transferable_principle: Run head seams from nape to hairline to flatten face while hiding seam under hair.

episodes.problem: Unwrapping ear and inner mouth detail regions.
episodes.observed_fact: Instructor cuts along ear back/length and bottom inner mouth tube.
episodes.instructor_claim: Cutting small details and hidden tube bottoms prevents facial stretching.
episodes.interpretation: Isolating inner cavity tubes allows flat UV unfolding.
episodes.hypothesis: Uncut mouth interior causes extreme UV stretching.
episodes.reference_evidence: Ears and mouth cavity unfold flat in UV editor.
episodes.modeling_decision: Add seams on ear backs and bottom of inner mouth tube.
episodes.visible_action: Selected ear and inner mouth edges, marked seams, unwrapped.
episodes.spoken_reason: Cut ear length and inner mouth bottom to allow clean opening.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Separates ear and mouth interior into clean flat UV islands.
episodes.transferable_principle: Slice tubular interior cavities along lower edges to enable clean flat unwrapping.

episodes.problem: Global UV texture stretching across complex face contours.
episodes.observed_fact: Instructor applies Minimum Stretch unwrap algorithm.
episodes.instructor_claim: Minimum Stretch automatically relaxes UVs to equalize texel density.
episodes.interpretation: Iterative relaxation algorithms balance area distortion on curved meshes.
episodes.hypothesis: Standard angle unwrap leaves uneven facial stretching.
episodes.reference_evidence: Checker texture becomes uniform across face in viewport.
episodes.visible_action: Pressed U, selected Minimum Stretch, observed UV relaxation.
episodes.spoken_reason: Use Minimum Stretch method to automatically reduce texture stretching.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Relaxes UV vertex spacing across facial curvature.
episodes.transferable_principle: Use distortion-minimizing unwrapping algorithms to reduce manual UV adjustments on organic meshes.

episodes.problem: Insufficient texture resolution on eyelids when closed during animation.
episodes.observed_fact: Instructor pins facial UVs, unpins eyelid loops, and scales eyelid UVs outward.
episodes.instructor_claim: Pinning facial UVs allows expanding eyelid UV space without distorting the face.
episodes.interpretation: Pinning locks surrounding UV topology during localized scaling.
episodes.hypothesis: Unpinned scaling would distort adjacent face UVs.
episodes.reference_evidence: Eyelid UV loops expand while pinned facial UVs remain locked.
episodes.modeling_decision: Pin facial UV island and scale unpinned eyelid loops.
episodes.visible_action: Pinned facial UVs (P), unpinned eyelid loops (Alt+P), scaled loops with S/G.
episodes.spoken_reason: Pin face UVs and expand eyelid loops to provide texture space for blinking.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Increases texel density on eyelids while locking face UVs.
episodes.transferable_principle: Pin surrounding UVs when modifying texel allocation on localized animated features.

episodes.problem: Inverted spherical UV projection distorting front eyeball area.
episodes.observed_fact: Initial unwrap inverted UVs. Adding a seam loop on rear hemisphere flips projection.
episodes.instructor_claim: Cutting rear hemisphere loop reverses projection, placing front eye at UV center.
episodes.interpretation: Rear seam placement centers front sphere features without front seams.
episodes.hypothesis: Longitudinal eyeball seams create visible iris seams.
episodes.reference_evidence: Checker texture aligns cleanly across front eyeball surface.
episodes.modeling_decision: Mark seam loop around back hemisphere of eye sphere.
episodes.visible_action: Selected rear hemisphere edge loop, marked seam, re-unwrapped.
episodes.spoken_reason: Cut back of eye sphere to reverse projection and eliminate front seams.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Forms continuous circular UV island centered on front eye.
episodes.failure: Initial unwrap created inverted projection with front eye stretched at perimeter.
episodes.correction: Moved seam loop to rear hemisphere to invert UV mapping projection.
episodes.transferable_principle: Place seam loops on rear hemisphere of spherical focal objects to obtain seamless front UVs.

episodes.problem: Allocating higher texture detail to iris vs non-visible rear eyeball.
episodes.observed_fact: Instructor pins iris/rim loops, scales up iris UVs, and shrinks rear eye island.
episodes.instructor_claim: Scaling iris UVs allocates more texel density where detail matters most.
episodes.interpretation: Non-uniform texel density prioritizes focal features over hidden areas.
episodes.hypothesis: Uniform texel density wastes resolution on invisible rear eyeball mesh.
episodes.reference_evidence: Iris UV rings enlarge; checker squares tighten on iris in 3D view.
episodes.modeling_decision: Scale up iris UVs and scale down rear eyeball UV island.
episodes.visible_action: Selected iris UVs with C, pinned, scaled up, scaled down rear island.
episodes.spoken_reason: Scale up iris UVs for detail and shrink back island to save space.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Increases iris texel density while reducing rear eye density.
episodes.transferable_principle: Scale focal UV regions up and shrink non-visible mesh UVs to optimize texel budget.

episodes.problem: Mirrored eyeball geometry sharing overlapping UV space.
episodes.observed_fact: Instructor offsets eye UV island, checks Mirror U in Mirror Modifier Data tab, and applies modifier.
episodes.instructor_claim: Mirror U automatically flips mirrored instance UVs across U axis upon applying modifier.
episodes.interpretation: Modifier UV mirroring options generate distinct non-overlapping UVs automatically.
episodes.hypothesis: Default mirror settings keep UVs stacked identically.
episodes.reference_evidence: Edit mode displays two mirrored non-overlapping eyeball UV islands.
episodes.modeling_decision: Enable Mirror U in Mirror Modifier Data tab before applying.
episodes.visible_action: Shifted UV island left, enabled Mirror U in modifier panel, applied modifier.
episodes.spoken_reason: Enable Mirror U so mirrored eyeball gets unique flipped UV space.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Generates separate mirrored UV island for right eye.
episodes.transferable_principle: Enable Mirror U/V in mirror modifiers to produce unique mirrored UV islands upon applying.
